commits.messageBody:
Implements DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0007I. Introduces non-serializable
TrustedInputCapability and fail-closed is_execution_eligible gate with
zero active adapters. No mutation adapter enabled; no runner/MCP/live
execution surface. Residual RouteDecision.is_runnable forge path remains
out of allowlist for 0007T/0007A.
commits.messageHeadline: feat(dcp): add trusted input capability boundary (0007I)

No mutation adapter enabled.
